allowed_vacuity: swap, skim and sync bubble a callee's revert data verbatim (the tokens' balanceOf and the uniswapV2Call callback are high-level calls), so no revert data can be excluded
spec: solar-verify's UniswapV2Pair spec (crates/verify/uniswap-v2/uniswap-v2.spec, ERC20 and Pair sections, exported with --emit-lean-spec): swap's fee-adjusted constant product, k non-decreasing, some input, outputs below the reserves, supply kept, lock released; skim keeps reserves and supply; sync keeps supply; the inherited ERC20 invariants
excluded: mint and burn: their exported ensures read statement-level ghosts (mintAmount0 = amount0 and the like) whose values depend on the tokens' answers; no world-dependent ghost step is written
ERC20 functions, permit, initialize, getters: not in the valid calls
deployment: the init code is not covered; any storage
reentrancy: a result only a world that changes the pair's storage during an external call explains is Shapes.Unadmitted, outside the specification's guarantee
resources: no gas bound (callees spend gas)
source model trusted: SolidCore's checked contract is the meaning of the source (frontend trust boundary)
calls: caller 0x2000, contract at 0x1000, the block and transaction of Target.message
